messages:
ana: small copy review — when users hit the per-minute rate limit on the hosted API we show `Rate limit exceeded`. support says users expect a hint about backoff and when to retry. can we make the inline error more actionable?

josh: totally. current server response includes a Retry-After header when we can tell them when to retry. if present, surface it like: `Try again in 12s`. otherwise give general guidance like `try reducing request rate or enable batching`.

kevin: keep it short in-line. something like: `Rate limit exceeded — try again in 12s or reduce request rate.` For accessibility combine with aria-live for SRs to announce the retry timing.

maya: tone note: avoid sounding punitive. prefer friendly helper language: `Whoa! You're sending requests fast. Try again in 12 seconds.` But that might be too casual for enterprise customers. maybe we keep neutral: `Rate limit reached` vs `Rate limit exceeded`. which is better?

ana: (typo: I meant ana) i prefer `Rate limit reached` — slightly softer. but `exceeded` is clearer technically. PM suggests `Rate limit reached` for UX.

josh: engineering prefers `exceeded` in logs. user-facing string can be different. proposal: inline for UI: `Rate limit reached. Try again in 12s or reduce request rate.` server error remains `429 Too Many Requests` and logs keep `exceeded`.

design-bot: suggested final inline copy variants (engineer-ready):
- Short (with Retry-After): "Rate limit reached. Try again in 12s or reduce request rate."
- Short (no Retry-After): "Rate limit reached. Reduce request rate or enable batching; see docs."
- Toast (transient): "Requests are being throttled for your account. View details."
- SR text (aria-live polite): "Rate limit reached. Retry available in twelve seconds. Reduce request rate or enable batching."

kevin: add a small helper link in the error row: `Learn how to batch requests` linking to docs. also include account-level quota info link for enterprise customers so they can request increases. keep links muted and non-intrusive.

maya: responsive/spacing nit: the inline error sits under the request form and can push the submit button off-screen on small viewports. prefer a compact single-line with middot + small link to expand details. e.g., `Rate limit reached · Try again in 12s · Learn more` where `Learn more` opens a small popover with bullets.

ana: engineers: we also need copy for the API JSON body returned to clients when we include Retry-After. propose {"error":"rate_limit_reached","message":"Rate limit reached. Try again in 12 seconds.","retry_after":12} so i18n teams have a clear message template.

josh: agree. also add an error_code field for Sentry: `rate_limit_reached` (snake_case).

design-bot: suggested JSON error schema strings (single-line): "error: rate_limit_reached", "message: Rate limit reached. Try again in {n} seconds.", "retry_after: {n}"

kevin: accessibility final checks: aria-live polite for inline, ensure the helper link is keyboard-focusable, and use high-contrast color for the error text. for screen readers prefer full words: `Try again in twelve seconds`. Intl teams will handle number formatting.

maya: i'll update the design spec with the single-line compact UI and the expanded popover content (bulleted): "What happened", "How to reduce requests", "Contact support for higher quota". tagging eng and docs to add the batching guide link.

ana: thanks all — i'll open the copy PR with the three variants and the JSON template. will include tests for small viewport wrapping.

josh: thumbs up. will ensure server returns Retry-After when possible and includes error_code.

kevin: nice! small emoji: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
